task: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. Launch Zotero. Find the book item titled 'Deep Learning' (by Goodfellow and Bengio) in the middle pane and select it. Add a child note to this item with the following text: 'foundational textbook on deep learning'. Save the note. Leave Zotero running so the note is persisted.
task_grounding: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. Launch Zotero. Find the book item titled 'Deep Learning' (by Goodfellow and Bengio) in the middle pane and select it. Add a child note to this item: right-click the item and choose 'Add Note', or click the Notes tab on the right-hand pane and click 'Add'. In the note body, type exactly this sentence: foundational textbook on deep learning. Save the note by clicking away or pressing Ctrl+S. Leave Zotero running so the note is persisted.

verification.description: Deep Learning item has a child note
A note contains the required phrase

cli_feasibility.translation: cli-anything-zotero --json item find "Deep Learning" && cli-anything-zotero --json note add <item_key> --text "foundational textbook on deep learning"
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI-Anything supports adding child notes to items via the 'note add' command. First find the item to get its key, then add the note with the exact text. Requires Zotero to be running (uses connector endpoint).
